conventions.name: db-schema-barrel-purity
conventions.description: apps/*/db/schema/index.ts re-exports its sibling schema files and nothing else — no local declarations, no non-schema imports. Evidence: 42/42 sibling schema files re-exported via `export * from` across both apps (tiffin-grab 23/23, puchkaman 19/19).

conventions.name: component-file-exports-matching-pascal-case
conventions.description: A component file components/**/{fileName}.tsx exports a symbol named PascalCase(fileName) — kebab-case filename, PascalCase component export. Evidence: manually verified across sampled files in tiffin-grab (identity-gate.tsx -> IdentityGate, status-banner.tsx -> StatusBanner, org-switcher.tsx -> OrgSwitcher, plan-hero.tsx -> PlanHero); consistent with the 228/228 kebab-case-filename finding from the broader evidence sweep. Files under __tests__ excluded (test files, not components).
